titleEs: Diablo.Trade vs Traderie — los dos marketplaces de D4
titleEn: Diablo.Trade vs Traderie — D4's two marketplaces
descriptionEs: Los dos marketplaces P2P principales de D4. Diablo.Trade es D4-only con higher volume; Traderie es multi-game con auctions feature.
descriptionEn: D4's two main P2P marketplaces. Diablo.Trade is D4-only with higher volume; Traderie is multi-game with auction features.
verdictEs: Diablo.Trade para day-to-day trading volume y D4-specific UX. Traderie como alternative para auctions de high-value items y cross-game collectors. Serious flippers monitor ambos.
verdictEn: Diablo.Trade for day-to-day trading volume and D4-specific UX. Traderie as an alternative for high-value item auctions and cross-game collectors. Serious flippers monitor both.

useCases.labelEs: Listing volume y buyer pool D4 específico
useCases.labelEn: D4-specific listing volume and buyer pool
useCases.reasonEs: Diablo.Trade es D4-only foco, lo que atrae más D4 traders. Traderie split between multiple games, smaller D4 community.
useCases.reasonEn: Diablo.Trade is D4-only focused, attracting more D4 traders. Traderie split between multiple games, smaller D4 community.

useCases.reasonEs: Traderie tiene auction feature built-in, mejor para items raros donde el real price emerges via bidding. Diablo.Trade es fixed-price only.
useCases.reasonEn: Traderie has built-in auction feature, better for rare items where real price emerges via bidding. Diablo.Trade is fixed-price only.

useCases.reasonEs: Diablo.Trade filters incluyen affixes, ilvl, aspects — D4-specific granularity. Traderie tiene filters más generics across games.
useCases.reasonEn: Diablo.Trade filters include affixes, ilvl, aspects — D4-specific granularity. Traderie has more generic cross-game filters.

useCases.reasonEs: Traderie cubre Pokemon, Adopt Me, MMOs. Si tradeas en varios games, single Traderie account vs separate Diablo.Trade.
useCases.reasonEn: Traderie covers Pokemon, Adopt Me, MMOs. If you trade across games, single Traderie account vs separate Diablo.Trade.

useCases.labelEs: Backup si una platform tiene downtime
useCases.labelEn: Backup if one platform has downtime
useCases.reasonEs: Diablo.Trade es la primary, infrequente downtime. Traderie ocasionalmente cae más por scope cross-game. Para D4 reliability, Diablo.Trade gana.
useCases.reasonEn: Diablo.Trade is primary, infrequent downtime. Traderie occasionally goes down more due to cross-game scope. For D4 reliability, Diablo.Trade wins.
